values.meaning: Stun duration (minimum, or if charged over 1 second)
values.quote: stuns them for {{fd|0.5}} seconds, increased to 1 second if ''Elastic Slingshot'' was charged for more than 1 second
values.binNote: ZacE.MinimumStun=0.5 matches the base stun; ZacE#MaxStun = MinimumStun*2 = 1.0 matches the increased stun. Both bin rows carry this value's numbers together.

values.meaning: health cost and cooldown refund fraction on cancel/no recast
values.quote: 50% of ''Elastic Slingshot's'' {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded
values.binNote: No bin row expresses a 50% refund fraction; ZacW.RefundOnBlobPickup=1 is unrelated (W ability). This appears to be tooltip/description-only logic not present as a data value in the sheet.

mechanics.claim: The ability is a channel that must be recast (or auto-recasts) to deal damage; damage occurs on landing, not on initial cast.
mechanics.quote: '''Zac''' {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location within the boundaries of the cone. Upon landing, he deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies

mechanics.claim: If Zac cancels the channel himself or it completes without reactivation, half the health cost and cooldown are refunded, implying the full cost/cooldown is otherwise paid.
mechanics.quote: If '''Zac''' {{tt|cancels|See notes}} the channel himself, or the charge completes without reactivation, 50% of ''Elastic Slingshot's'' {{sti|{{as|health cost}}}} and {{sti|cooldown}} are refunded.

mechanics.claim: Cooldown starts after the dash/landing effect, not on initial cast.
Stretching Strikes and Unstable Matter interrupt the channel, while Let's Bounce! initiates the recast and is buffered to cast at the end of the dash.
mechanics.quote: {{ai|Stretching Strikes|Zac}} and {{ai|Unstable Matter|Zac}} interrupt. {{ai|Let's Bounce!|Zac}} initiates the recast and is buffered to cast itself at the end of the dash.

mechanics.claim: The knockup will not occur if the target location is directly on top of Zac, in which case he does not dash at all (and presumably deals no damage).
mechanics.quote: ''Elastic Slingshot'' will not {{tip|airborne|knock up}} if the targeted location was directly on top of '''Zac''' (in which case he will not {{tip|dash}} at all).
